title: Sindh Development Authorities Laws Revival and Amending Ordinance 2006

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Development Authorities Laws Revival and Amending Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2007
ORDINANCE I OF 2007
SINDH DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITIES LAWS
(REVIVAL AND
AMENDING) ORDINANCE, 2006
An Ordinance to revive
and amend the certain laws
relating to the
Development Authorities in the
Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
1st February, 2007]
No.S.Legis:1(1)/2007, dated 1-2-2007.---The Following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:---
Preamble.---Whereas in order to
give impetuous and encourage the housing industry and provide shelter to the
people of the Province, it is expedient to revive and amend the laws relating
to the Malir Development Authority Act, 1993 and Lyari Development Authority Act, 1993;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:---
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Development Authorities Laws (Revival and Amending)
Ordinance, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 27th December, 2006.

3. Saving.---All orders made,
proceedings taken, appointments made, acts done by any authority, or by any
person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been made, taken
or done between the first day of July, two thousand and two, and the data on
which this Ordinance comes into force (both days inclusive), shall
notwithstanding any judgment of any court be deemed to be and always to have
been validly made, taken or done under the said laws and shall not be called in
question in any court or forum on any ground whatsoever.
